title: Lucky Llama Fiesta
infoTitle: LUCKY LLAMA FIESTA · HOW IT PLAYS

tiers.name: LEGENDARY FIESTA
tiers.tag: Don Lucho dances on the table. The whole plaza cheers.

tiers.name: EPIC FIESTA
tiers.tag: Confetti, trumpets and a very proud llama.

text.idle: PLACE YOUR BET AND JOIN THE FIESTA
text.lose: NO WIN THIS TIME. SPIN AGAIN, AMIGO!

buys.name: Poncho Parade
buys.text: The Fiesta Drums roll in and the parade starts: 8 or more free spins. Every poncho wild sticks and the multiplier ladder climbs up to x10.
buys.confirmText: PONCHO PARADE: 3 or more drums land, then 8+ free spins with sticky ponchos and a multiplier ladder up to x10.

buys.name: Piñata Link
buys.text: Start with 6 money piñatas locked in place. Land more to reset the respins, crack them all for cash and win MINI, MINOR, MAJOR or GRAND.
buys.confirmText: PIÑATA LINK: 6 piñatas land, 3 respins that reset with every new piñata, then every piñata is cracked for its prize. Jackpots up to 2,000x.

buys.name: Party Pack
buys.text: The big one: Poncho Parade that starts with 3 sticky ponchos already on the board, so the x3 multiplier is live from the first spin.
buys.confirmText: PARTY PACK: Poncho Parade that starts with 3 sticky ponchos (multiplier x3 from the first free spin).

intro.quote: "Every poncho sticks. Every stripe pays more."
intro.tap: TAP ANYWHERE TO START THE PARADE

outro.label: PARADE TOTAL
outro.quote: "What a party! Come back tomorrow, amigo."

fever.name: Fiesta Luck
fever.text: Pay 2x per spin: Fiesta Drums and money piñatas land about three times as often, so Poncho Parade and Piñata Link come much more often. Stays on until you switch it off.
fever.onMsg: FIESTA LUCK ON. TOTAL BET x2

features.title: PIÑATA LINK
features.text: 6+ money piñatas lock and respin. New ones reset the respins. Crack them for cash and jackpots up to 2,000x.

features.title: PONCHO PARADE
features.text: 3+ Fiesta Drums give 8 to 20 free spins. Every wild poncho sticks and the multiplier climbs to x10.

features.title: STICKY PONCHOS
features.text: Each poncho adds a ladder stripe: x1, x2, x3, x5, x8, x10. Don Lucho collects every piñata.
